intro: Inspired by the first light of dawn, Ray brings energy into your bedroom. With an LED-lit headboard and motorised storage, your bedroom becomes a sanctuary of light, comfort, and effortless living.

features.title: Designed to capture the beauty of morning light
features.text: Designed to evoke the calm and warmth of morning light, this bed brings a serene, uplifting vibe to your bedroom, setting the perfect mood for relaxation.

features.title: Headboard with led light strip
features.text: Create a soft, ambient glow with the built-in LED light strip, making the bed a stylish focal point while offering practical lighting for your nighttime routine.

features.title: Headboard with built-in storage
features.text: Maximise space with convenient storage in the headboard, ideal for keeping books, gadgets, and other essentials close by, but out of sight.

features.title: Electro-mechanical lift-up storage
features.text: Effortlessly access ample under-bed storage with the motorised lift-up mechanism, keeping your room organised without lifting a finger.

features.title: Dual hues, double the elegance
features.text: The sophisticated duo-tone finish complements any décor, adding a touch of modern elegance to your bedroom while maintaining warmth and style.

name: Ray King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Motorized Storage
